is.t: 1. Strong Control Environment – score ≥ 95% and no Insufficient Control
2. Moderate Control Environment – score ≥ 90% and Insufficient ≤ 5% of applicable
3. Weak Control Environment – score ≥ 75% and Insufficient < 10% of applicable
4. Critical Attention Required – score < 75% or Insufficient ≥ 10% of applicable
5. Insufficient Data – > 10% missing/invalid answers or < 50% applicable questions

Score uses the established workbook weights (Config - Configuracion: UNDER 1, MODERATE 0.75, INSUFFICIENT 0). The 100/50/0 column is a sensitivity check only. All thresholds are an ANALYTICAL MODEL that requires management validation – not official DHL scoring criteria.
